inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment DefinitionBodyItem returns SysML::Type :
	  ownedRelationship += DefinitionMember 
	| ownedRelationship += VariantUsageMember
	| ownedRelationship += NonOccurrenceUsageMember
	| ( ownedRelationship += EmptySuccessionMember )?
	  ownedRelationship += OccurrenceUsageMember	
	| ownedRelationship += AliasMember
	| => ownedRelationship += Import
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.6.1 states DefinitionBodyItem : Type = ownedRelationship += DefinitionMember | ownedRelationship += VariantUsageMember | ownedRelationship += NonOccurrenceUsageMember | ( ownedRelationship += SourceSuccessionMember )? ownedRelationship += OccurrenceUsageMember | ownedRelationship += AliasMember | ownedRelationship += Import. The SysML Xtext writes the same alternatives, naming the optional leading member EmptySuccessionMember and putting a `=>` predicate on Import; the renaming and the predicate are not ported. The rule is the clause as written.
